Pairwise Dissimilarity of Concordance Profiles

Source: R/calibrate.R
geomorphon_profile_dist.Rd

Computes the pairwise dissimilarity matrix between conditional probability profiles from a contingency table or geomorphon_concordance() output using exact base-2 Jensen-Shannon divergence (default) or any method supported by philentropy.

Usage

geomorphon_profile_dist(
  x,
  margin = 1,
  method = "jensen-shannon",
  unit = "log2"
)

Arguments

x

A geomorphon_concordance result list (containing contingency_table) or a 2D contingency table or numeric matrix.

margin

Integer indicating the profile direction: 1 for row profiles (e.g. \(P(\text{Category} \mid \text{Geomorphon})\)), or 2 for column profiles (e.g. \(P(\text{Geomorphon} \mid \text{Category})\)). Default is 1.

method

Character string specifying distance metric. Default is "jensen-shannon".

unit

Logarithm unit ("log2", "log", "log10"). Default is "log2".

Value

A symmetric numeric distance matrix with row and column names matching the profile labels.

Examples

ct <- matrix(c(10, 0, 5, 5, 0, 10), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)
rownames(ct) <- c("Flat", "Slope", "Ridge")
colnames(ct) <- c("CatA", "CatB")
geomorphon_profile_dist(ct, margin = 1)
#>            Flat     Slope     Ridge
#> Flat  0.0000000 0.3112781 1.0000000
#> Slope 0.3112781 0.0000000 0.3112781
#> Ridge 1.0000000 0.3112781 0.0000000
